title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-11
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a rare Row Jimmy with Brent’s fiery solo; reviewers praise the youthful guitar and energetic playing despite limited technical commentary.
ai_review.review: The recording, presumed to be a sound‑board source, is praised for its musical moments – notably a gritty, youthful Jerry Garcia lead and a hellacious, angry keyboard solo from Brent Mydland. Reviewers also highlight the rarity of “Row Jimmy” in the 1982 setlist and give a nod to the overall energy of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave high star ratings (5, 5, 4) and highlighted strong playing; recording quality is assumed good but not explicitly described.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on sound clarity or mix; presumed clear soundboard capture based on file naming.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Youthful, gritty guitar work praised as soulful and gritty.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent delivers an angry, hellacious keyboard solo that stands out.
